page_title: GeoCheckTool — AI search visibility diagnosis for brands

sources.entry: AIRanked - Free AI visibility checker for tracking brand mentions across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overview. #free #seo

summary.name: GeoCheckTool
summary.one_liner: GeoCheckTool is a brand AI-search visibility diagnosis tool that tests how named AI and search surfaces describe a business, keeps the evidence, turns confirmed gaps into website-repair tasks, and retests the same frozen question scope.
keywords: check how ai describes my business
use_cases: diagnose how AI assistants describe a local business
track which buyer questions mention or cite a brand
find factual gaps in AI answers about services or pricing
plan and verify website fixes after an AI answer error
measure Chinese AI assistant answers for international brands
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a workflow: the customer first confirms business facts (name, pricing, services, locations) to form a Business Truth Profile, and a buyer-question bank is generated or edited. Selected questions are then measured repeatedly on named surfaces, currently Perplexity Sonar via OpenRouter/RAG API and Google AI Overview via SerpApi, with per-question evidence linking answer spans, citations and provider state. Accepted findings become versioned website-repair and source-building task packages that the customer executes, and read-only checks can verify whether a public change went live. Later runs reuse the frozen scope so results can be compared, reported as distributions rather than a stable rank. A separate China service uses a logged-in Doubao consumer client for evidence-grade measurement.
notable: Business Truth Profile: customer-confirmed facts used to check whether AI answers are factually supported, not just whether the brand appears
Frozen, versioned question scope with repeated samples (n=3 Quick, n=5 Formal) so retests stay comparable
Read-only system verification of published website changes, explicitly separate from AI outcome measurement
Separate China service using a logged-in Doubao consumer client with per-question evidence packets
caveats: Free tier is one Quick diagnosis per account; Formal tier uses 200 credits per batch and pricing details are on a separate pricing page
Does not automatically publish or take over a CMS; customers execute repairs or hire help
Results are observed distributions with uncertainty, not a stable ranking, market share, or causal guarantee
Surface coverage is limited to named routes (Perplexity Sonar via OpenRouter, Google AI Overview via SerpApi); the page says directional API evidence is not a signed-in consumer-client result
